name: Core Automation
summary: Core Automation is an AI research lab focused on automating research itself.
overview: Core Automation describes itself as an AI research lab focused on automating research. It emerged publicly in 2026; reported financing data is treated as reported context because the company has not published a financing announcement.

facts.label: Reported seed financing
facts.note: Reported 2026 financing; later target valuation was not a completed disclosed round.

bull_case: A research-automation platform could have strategic value if it produces a materially faster research loop than conventional lab teams and can turn that capability into durable products.
bear_case: The company has disclosed little about technical results, customers or commercial traction. Reported financing should not be mistaken for proof of a repeatable business model.
directory_notes: It reportedly raised $100M at a $1B valuation in 2026; a larger follow-on discussed in reporting was not a completed disclosed round.

intelligence.description: AI research lab pursuing systems that automate and optimize research workflows.
company: Core Automation presents itself as an AI research lab pursuing systems that automate the research process. Its public materials provide limited technical and commercial detail beyond that mission.

A $100M financing at a $1B valuation has been reported by private-market data providers, but the company has not published a transaction announcement. The profile labels that claim as reported rather than company-confirmed.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Research automation is a high-upside but hard-to-verify category: the key question is whether agents can create reliable, compounding research output rather than simply automate isolated tasks. Independent evidence of technical performance and paid adoption is still needed.
